messages.text: Rain on the pavement and the weight of a 250,000-page proof

A persistent rain settles over Canton today as the community navigates shifting local construction news. Meanwhile, the scientific community is grappling with massive new computational proofs that challenge our understanding of mathematics.
Expect rain throughout the day with temperatures reaching a high of 46 degrees and dropping to a low of 33 degrees.
The sun rises at 7:38 AM and sets at 5:04 PM, with the moon currently in a waning gibbous phase at 96 percent illumination.
Quiet moments in a rainy landscape
With no local events scheduled for today, it is a suitable time to stay indoors and catch up on reading.
Looking toward next week, the Last Call Improv show in Hamtramck offers a free evening of comedy on December 3 at 9 PM.
Data center construction halts in Van Buren

Wayne County has issued a stop-work order for the Google-linked Project Cannoli data center, citing a lack of required construction permits. This development arrives alongside new research suggesting that the rapid growth of such facilities may complicate Michigan’s 2035 renewable energy targets.
Consider heading to Hamtramck on December 3 for the free Last Call Improv show at 9 PM.
